scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Lance presents a hotel voice and chat agent that connects guest requests to reservations, housekeeping and operational tracking.
explains_well: The pool-party example keeps the guest conversation beside restaurant and housekeeping records, including eight people and a confirmed room request.
unclear: The original request to extend the stay does not receive an equally clear final old-date/new-date booking confirmation.
scenario: Extend a hotel stay, reserve dinner for eight and arrange pool towels.
product_clear_basis: The guest request to extend a stay appears, followed by hotel identity and availability cards.

sound.detail: The coherent ASR draft describes existing-system connections, then a guest asks to extend a stay and book dinner for eight. The agent offers a restaurant and towels, proposes availability at eight and promises confirmations. Later text claims voice/text service, several languages, policy compliance and request tracking. Brand and language-name recognition contain errors; the draft does not validate voice quality or actual fulfillment.

lessons.keep: Keep the request and the corresponding changed system record visible together.
lessons.avoid: Avoid claiming an end-to-end result while one original request has no clear final record.
lessons.open: Actual integration, changed stay dates, real bookings, physical delivery, metric basis and heard audio properties remain unverified.
try: For Tin, finish a multistep request with one receipt listing every requested outcome.
Use brighter text and fewer simultaneous cards when showing action details on a dark background.
